Title: Nezha: OAuth2 redirect_uri Host header injection regression when dashboard_host is empty
Description: Nezha v2.2.3 regresses the GHSA-9rc6-8cjv-rcvx host header injection fix for deployments where the new `dashboard_host` setting is empty. In that configuration, `/api/v1/oauth2/{provider}` again reflects the request `Host` header into the OAuth2 `redirect_uri` sent to the identity provider, even if `install_host` is configured.
Solution: Unfortunately, there is no solution available yet.
